source_text: Please make sure to submit the quarterly financial report by Friday afternoon.
reference: कृपया शुक्रवार दोपहर तक त्रैमासिक वित्तीय रिपोर्ट जमा करना सुनिश्चित करें।
cultural_context: Formal corporate communication requiring polite imperative (कृपया/करें) rather than informal command.

source_text: The company raised 15 million dollars in its Series B round.
reference: कंपनी ने अपने सीरीज बी राउंड में लगभग 125 करोड़ रुपये (15 मिलियन डॉलर) जुटाए।
cultural_context: Localization of currency and numbering scale: converting millions/dollars to crores/rupees for Indian business audience.

source_text: Don't beat around the bush; just tell me what happened.
reference: इधर-उधर की बातें मत करो, सीधे बताओ क्या हुआ।
cultural_context: Idiomatic adaptation of 'beat around the bush' to 'इधर-उधर की बातें करना' instead of literal shrub beating.

source_text: Are you coming to the office tomorrow or working from home?
reference: Kal office aa rahe ho ya work from home karoge?
cultural_context: Natural urban workplace Hinglish code-switching blending Hindi syntax with common English professional nouns.

source_text: Grandmother is resting in her room; please do not make noise.
reference: दादी जी अपने कमरे में आराम कर रही हैं, कृपया शोर न करें।
cultural_context: Honorific suffix 'जी' (दादी जी) and plural verb agreement (कर रही हैं) denoting respect for elders in Indian households.

source_text: Bro, chill out, we will easily find a quick fix for this issue.
reference: Bhai chill kar, is issue ka koi na koi jugaad nikal lenge.
cultural_context: Colloquial term 'jugaad' (ingenious makeshift solution) and friendly address 'Bhai' typical of modern Indian youth.

source_text: We apologize for the delay. Your refund of 500 rupees has been initiated.
reference: देरी के लिए हम क्षमा चाहते हैं। आपके 500 रुपये का रिफंड शुरू कर दिया गया है।
cultural_context: Formal customer support apology using respectful vocabulary (क्षमा चाहते हैं).

source_text: A bird in hand is worth two in the bush.
reference: नौ नकद न तेरह उधार।
cultural_context: Proverbial equivalence: English bird-in-hand corresponds to the classical Hindi idiom 'नौ नकद न तेरह उधार'.

source_text: Wishing you and your family a very happy and prosperous Diwali!
reference: आपको और आपके परिवार को दीपावली की हार्दिक एवं सुखद शुभकामनाएं!
cultural_context: Festive greetings requiring auspicious high-register vocabulary (हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं) for Deepawali.

source_text: आप चिंता मत कीजिए, मैं चाय-पानी का इंतजाम देखता हूँ।
reference: Don't worry, I will arrange for the refreshments and hospitality.
cultural_context: 'चाय-पानी' encompasses tea, snacks, and customary hospitality, not literally just tea and plain water.

source_text: Let's grab some roadside snacks after college.
reference: College ke baad chal na, tapri pe chai aur street food khate hain.
cultural_context: 'Tapri' is the quintessential Indian roadside tea kiosk culture.

source_text: The patient has mild fever and body ache; please consult a physician immediately.
reference: मरीज को हल्का बुखार और बदन दर्द है; कृपया तुरंत चिकित्सक से परामर्श लें।
cultural_context: Clinical clarity requiring unambiguous formal medical terms (चिकित्सक से परामर्श लें).

source_text: It is raining cats and dogs outside, take an umbrella.
reference: बाहर मूसलाधार बारिश हो रही है, छाता साथ ले लो।
cultural_context: Idiom translation: 'मूसलाधार बारिश' (torrential rain) instead of literal cats and dogs.

source_text: I pushed the code to the main branch, please review the PR.
reference: Maine code main branch pe push kar diya hai, please PR review kar lo.
cultural_context: Tech industry Hinglish: git terminology kept in English with Hindi auxiliary verbs (kar diya hai).

source_text: Respectful greetings to the honorable Chief Guest on this auspicious occasion.
reference: इस पावन अवसर पर माननीय मुख्य अतिथि का सादर अभिनंदन।
cultural_context: High-register Sanskritized Hindi (पावन अवसर, माननीय मुख्य अतिथि, सादर अभिनंदन) for ceremonial protocol.

source_text: यह तो ऊंट के मुंह में जीरा के समान है।
reference: This is merely a drop in the ocean.
cultural_context: Proverbial mapping: 'ऊंट के मुंह में जीरा' (cumin seed in camel's mouth) maps to 'a drop in the ocean'.

source_text: The price of the apartment is 2.5 crore rupees.
reference: इस फ्लैट की कीमत ढाई करोड़ (2.5 करोड़) रुपये है।
cultural_context: Use of Indian numbering scale (Crores) and fractional terms like ढाई (2.5).

source_text: Why are you taking so much stress? Everything will be sorted.
reference: Itna tension kyun le raha hai? Sab theek ho jayega yaar.
cultural_context: 'Tension lena' is the ubiquitous Indian English/Hinglish idiom for worrying.

source_text: The teacher explained the concept with practical real-world examples.
reference: अध्यापिका ने व्यावहारिक और वास्तविक उदाहरणों के साथ अवधारणा स्पष्ट की।
cultural_context: Pedagogical discourse maintaining formal academic register.

source_text: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep before the interval.
reference: Movie itni boring thi ki main interval se pehle hi so gaya.
cultural_context: Cinema culture references 'interval' (customary in Indian theatres) and conversational code-mixing.

source_text: To kill two birds with one stone.
reference: एक तीर से दो शिकार करना।
cultural_context: Equivalent idiom: 'एक पंथ दो काज' or 'एक तीर से दो शिकार'.

source_text: वह बहुत हवाबाज़ी करता है, असल में कुछ नहीं जानता।
reference: He bluffs and shows off a lot, but in reality he knows nothing.
cultural_context: 'हवाबाज़ी' is Northern Indian colloquialism for boastful posturing or bluffing.

source_text: Please confirm your delivery address: Flat 402, Shanti Apartments, MG Road, Bengaluru.
reference: कृपया अपने डिलीवरी पते की पुष्टि करें: फ्लैट 402, शांति अपार्टमेंट्स, एमजी रोड, बेंगलुरु।
cultural_context: Transliteration of Indian address entities while translating functional text.

source_text: Order a pizza, everyone is hungry here.
reference: Yaar pizza order kar de, sabko bahut bhookh lagi hai yahan.
cultural_context: Natural blend of English noun 'pizza' with Hindi grammar and conversational particle 'Yaar'.

source_text: She took a leave of absence to celebrate Raksha Bandhan with her brother.
reference: उसने अपने भाई के साथ रक्षाबंधन मनाने के लिए छुट्टी ली।
cultural_context: Cultural holiday context of sibling bond celebrated across India.

source_text: The distance between the two villages is approximately 15 kilometers.
reference: दोनों गांवों के बीच की दूरी लगभग 15 किलोमीटर है।
cultural_context: Metric unit localization (किलोमीटर).

source_text: Can you send the presentation deck before the client call?
reference: Client call se pehle presentation deck bhej sakte ho kya?
cultural_context: Indian corporate Hinglish question structure ending with 'kya'.

source_text: Better late than never.
reference: देर आए दुरुस्त आए।
cultural_context: Common Urdu-Hindi idiom pairing 'देर आए दुरुस्त आए'.

source_text: बड़ों के पैर छूकर आशीर्वाद लेना हमारी परंपरा है।
reference: Seeking blessings by touching the feet of elders is part of our tradition.
cultural_context: 'चरण स्पर्श' / 'पैर छूना' is a fundamental Indian gesture of reverence requiring culturally descriptive translation.

source_text: The traffic near the Silk Board junction is completely jammed today.
reference: Aaj Silk Board junction ke paas traffic poora jam hai.
cultural_context: Local landmark reference with common urban commute vocabulary.

source_text: Please keep your seat belts fastened until the aircraft comes to a complete halt.
reference: विमान के पूरी तरह रुकने तक कृपया अपनी सीट बेल्ट बांधे रखें।
cultural_context: Standard aviation safety announcement in standardized Hindi.

source_text: The farmer harvested 50 quintals of wheat from his fields.
reference: किसान ने अपने खेतों से 50 क्विंटल गेहूं की फसल काटी।
cultural_context: Traditional agricultural measurement (क्विंटल = 100 kg) widely used across Indian farming.

source_text: I will ping you on WhatsApp once I reach home.
reference: Ghar pahunch kar WhatsApp pe ping karta hoon.
cultural_context: Modern daily communication Hinglish with WhatsApp as ubiquitous messaging platform.

source_text: उसकी बातों में मत आना, वह मीठी छुरी है।
reference: Don't fall for his words; he is a wolf in sheep's clothing.
cultural_context: 'मीठी छुरी' (sweet knife) signifies a hypocritical, deceptively polite traitor.

source_text: The software update will fix critical security bugs.
reference: यह सॉफ़्टवेयर अपडेट महत्वपूर्ण सुरक्षा खामियों को ठीक करेगा।
cultural_context: Technical software translation with accurate vocabulary (खामियों = vulnerabilities/bugs).

source_text: Let's plan a Goa trip for the long weekend.
reference: Long weekend ke liye Goa trip plan karte hain yaar.
cultural_context: Iconic Indian millennial long weekend trope (Goa trip).

source_text: Where there is a will, there is a way.
reference: जहाँ चाह, वहाँ राह।
cultural_context: Classic proverb parity: 'जहाँ चाह, वहाँ राह'.

source_text: Uncle and Aunt have arrived from Lucknow for the wedding ceremony.
reference: चाचा जी और चाची जी शादी समारोह के लिए लखनऊ से आ चुके हैं।
cultural_context: Kinship specificity in Indian languages (paternal uncle = चाचा vs maternal = मामा).

source_text: दाल में कुछ काला लग रहा है।
reference: Something seems fishy here.
cultural_context: Hindi culinary idiom 'दाल में कुछ काला' matches English 'something smells fishy'.

source_text: The interviewer asked some very tricky questions about system design.
reference: Interviewer ne system design pe kaafi tricky questions pooche the.
cultural_context: Tech interview conversation in bilingual tech worker community.

source_text: Government of India has launched a new scholarship scheme for students.
reference: भारत सरकार ने विद्यार्थियों के लिए एक नई छात्रवृत्ति योजना शुरू की है।
cultural_context: Official state governance register (भारत सरकार, छात्रवृत्ति योजना).

source_text: Barking dogs seldom bite.
reference: जो गरजते हैं, वो बरसते नहीं।
cultural_context: Monsoon/cloud metaphor in Hindi replacing canine metaphor in English.

source_text: वह हमेशा अपनी ढपली अपना राग अलापता रहता है।
reference: He always blows his own trumpet and marches to his own tune.
cultural_context: 'अपनी ढपली अपना राग' (own tambourine, own tune) signifies stubborn individualism or self-absorption.

source_text: Don't overthink it, just take the decision.
reference: Zyada overthink mat kar, seedha decision le le.
cultural_context: Casual youth dialogue incorporating English cognitive verbs with Hindi imperatives.

source_text: Our store will remain closed on 15th August on the occasion of Independence Day.
reference: स्वतंत्रता दिवस के अवसर पर 15 अगस्त को हमारा प्रतिष्ठान बंद रहेगा।
cultural_context: National holiday announcement using formal retail term (प्रतिष्ठान/दुकान).

source_text: Please accept our heartfelt condolences on your tragic loss.
reference: इस अपूरणीय क्षति पर हमारी हार्दिक संवेदनाएं स्वीकार करें।
cultural_context: Condolence etiquette requiring somber respectful phrasing (अपूरणीय क्षति, हार्दिक संवेदनाएं).

source_text: Did you check the budget? We cannot exceed 50k.
reference: Budget check kiya kya? 50k se zyada exceed nahi kar sakte.
cultural_context: Everyday financial discussion in urban India.

source_text: चलो, अब गंगा नहाए! प्रोजेक्ट पूरा हो गया।
reference: What a relief, now we can breathe easy! The project is finally complete.
cultural_context: 'गंगा नहाना' (bathing in the sacred Ganges) metaphorically denotes a massive sigh of relief after fulfilling an arduous duty.

source_text: The patient must take one tablet twice daily after meals.
reference: मरीज़ को भोजन के बाद दिन में दो बार एक गोली लेनी चाहिए।
cultural_context: Medical prescription instructions needing unambiguous dosage guidance.

source_text: That stand-up comedian was hilarious, my stomach started hurting from laughing.
reference: Woh stand-up comedian itna funny tha ki hans-hans ke pet dard ho gaya.
cultural_context: Indian stand-up comedy culture reaction using typical idiom 'hans-hans ke pet dard hona'.

source_text: Actions speak louder than words.
reference: बातों से ज्यादा काम बोलते हैं।
cultural_context: Universal proverb with natural Hindi phrasing ('कथनी से करनी भली').

source_text: सावन के अंधे को हरा ही हरा नजर आता है।
reference: One who has only seen good times assumes everything is always rosy.
cultural_context: Agricultural monsoon proverb reflecting narrow perception born of sheltered prosperity.

source_text: The bank balance shows an opening balance of 2,50,000 rupees.
reference: बैंक खाते में प्रारंभिक शेष राशि 2,50,000 (दो लाख पचास हजार) रुपये है।
cultural_context: Indian comma grouping (2,50,000) and banking terminology (प्रारंभिक शेष राशि).

source_text: I will book an Uber right away so we don't get late for the movie.
reference: Main abhi Uber book karta hoon taaki movie ke liye late na ho jayein.
cultural_context: Ride-hailing vocabulary embedded in conversational Hindi syntax.

source_text: He bought 10 tolas of gold for his daughter's wedding.
reference: उन्होंने अपनी बेटी के विवाह के लिए 10 तोले सोना खरीदा।
cultural_context: 'Tola' (10 grams) is traditional gold weight measurement essential in Indian wedding contexts.

source_text: Honesty is the best policy.
reference: ईमानदारी सर्वोत्तम नीति है।
cultural_context: Standard moral maxim translation widely used in school curricula.

source_text: अरे भाई, जरा नमक इधर खिसकाना।
reference: Hey brother, could you please pass the salt?
cultural_context: Colloquial dining table request using familiar particle 'अरे भाई' and softening adverb 'जरा'.

source_text: My phone battery died in the middle of the Zoom meeting.
reference: Zoom meeting ke beech mein hi mere phone ki battery die ho gayi.
cultural_context: Modern remote work reality phrased in natural Hinglish.

source_text: All passengers travelling on train 12951 are requested to proceed to platform number 3.
reference: गाड़ी संख्या 12951 से यात्रा करने वाले सभी यात्रियों से निवेदन है कि वे प्लेटफार्म नंबर 3 पर पहुंचे।
cultural_context: Indian Railways public address system register (गाड़ी संख्या, यात्रियों से निवेदन है).

source_text: To add fuel to the fire.
reference: आग में घी डालना।
cultural_context: Sacrificial ritual fire metaphor in Hindi ('घी डालना') vs English fuel/petrol.

source_text: शादी में पूरा मोहल्ला उमड़ पड़ा था।
reference: The entire neighborhood turned up for the wedding.
cultural_context: 'मोहल्ला' reflects tight-knit community living in traditional Indian towns.

source_text: I am craving some spicy momos right now.
reference: Yaar abhi bohot teekhe momos khane ka mann kar raha hai.
cultural_context: Craving expression 'mann kar raha hai' with popular North Indian street food 'momos'.

source_text: The Prime Minister addressed the nation on the eve of Republic Day.
reference: प्रधानमंत्री ने गणतंत्र दिवस की पूर्व संध्या पर राष्ट्र को संबोधित किया।
cultural_context: State diplomatic protocol (गणतंत्र दिवस की पूर्व संध्या, राष्ट्र को संबोधित किया).

source_text: Do not bite the hand that feeds you.
reference: जिस थाली में खाना, उसी में छेद नहीं करते।
cultural_context: Proverbial equivalence: 'जिस थाली में खाना उसी में छेद करना' is the exact Indian cultural idiom.

source_text: अरे यार, तू तो ईद का चाँद हो गया है!
reference: Hey buddy, you have become as rare as a blue moon!
cultural_context: 'ईद का चाँद' (crescent moon of Eid) signifies seeing someone very rarely, matching English 'once in a blue moon'.

source_text: Can we reschedule the sync to 4 PM? I have a back-to-back demo.
reference: Sync ko 4 PM reschedule kar sakte hain? Meri back-to-back demo hai.
cultural_context: Corporate calendar sync Hinglish.

source_text: The price of petrol has increased by two rupees per liter.
reference: पेट्रोल की कीमत में दो रुपये प्रति लीटर की वृद्धि हुई है।
cultural_context: Economic news reporting style.

source_text: Cleanliness is next to godliness.
reference: स्वच्छता में ही ईश्वर का वास होता है।
cultural_context: Moral axiom localization rooted in Swachh Bharat and traditional cultural ethics.

source_text: वह बात का बतंगड़ बनाने में माहिर है।
reference: She is an expert at making a mountain out of a molehill.
cultural_context: 'बात का बतंगड़ बनाना' directly parallels 'making a mountain out of a molehill'.

source_text: Bro, that reel went viral overnight with over 1 million views.
reference: Bhai woh reel overnight viral ho gayi, 10 lakh se zyada views aa gaye.
cultural_context: Creator economy Hinglish converting 1 million into 10 lakh naturally.

source_text: Please enter your One-Time Password (OTP) received on your registered mobile number.
reference: कृपया अपने पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर पर प्राप्त वन-टाइम पासवर्ड (ओटीपी) दर्ज करें।
cultural_context: Standard authentication UI string in Indian fintech apps.

source_text: Every cloud has a silver lining.
reference: हर निराशा के पीछे आशा की किरण होती है।
cultural_context: Idiomatic translation conveying optimism without cloud/silver weather literalism.

source_text: आपसे मिलकर बड़ी खुशी हुई, फिर कभी फुरसत में बैठेंगे।
reference: It was wonderful meeting you, let's catch up at leisure sometime.
cultural_context: 'फुरसत में बैठना' captures the relaxed social catchup tradition in North India.

source_text: Let's binge-watch that new web series tonight.
reference: Aaj raat ko woh nayi web series binge-watch karte hain.
cultural_context: OTT streaming slang adopted across urban Indian youth.

source_text: The doctor advised him to avoid oily food and take rest for a week.
reference: चिकित्सक ने उन्हें तैलीय भोजन से परहेज करने और एक सप्ताह विश्राम करने की सलाह दी।
cultural_context: Dietary caution phrasing ('परहेज करना' / 'तैलीय भोजन').

source_text: Look before you leap.
reference: बिना विचारे जो करे, सो पाछे पछताय।
cultural_context: Classical Kabir couplet idiom parallel ('बिना विचारे जो करे').

source_text: उसने मेरी नाक में दम कर रखा है।
reference: He has been driving me up the wall.
cultural_context: 'नाक में दम करना' (suffocating the nose) means annoying/harassing incessantly.

source_text: Are you ready? The cab will reach your location in 2 minutes.
reference: Ready ho gaye kya? Cab 2 minute mein tumhari location pe aa jayegi.
cultural_context: Daily ride hailing conversational query.

source_text: Please keep silence inside the library premises.
reference: कृपया पुस्तकालय परिसर में शांति बनाए रखें।
cultural_context: Institutional signage standard Hindi.

source_text: Strike while the iron is hot.
reference: लोहा गर्म है, हथौड़ा मार दो।
cultural_context: Direct proverb translation preserved in Hindi folklore.

source_text: अरे भाई, थोड़ा एडजस्ट कर लो, जगह कम है।
reference: Hey buddy, please adjust a little, space is tight.
cultural_context: The classic Indian public transit / shared seat 'adjust' philosophy.

source_text: The biryani at that place is next level, we must go there this Sunday.
reference: Us jagah ki biryani ekdum next level hai, is Sunday chalte hain.
cultural_context: Foodie enthusiasm using 'ekdum next level' in conversational Hinglish.

source_text: The Supreme Court dismissed the petition citing lack of evidence.
reference: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने साक्ष्यों के अभाव का हवाला देते हुए याचिका खारिज कर दी।
cultural_context: Formal Indian jurisprudence terminology (सर्वोच्च न्यायालय, साक्ष्यों के अभाव, याचिका खारिज).

source_text: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
reference: जैसा देश, वैसा भेष।
cultural_context: Rhyming cultural maxim equivalence: 'जैसा देश, वैसा भेष'.

source_text: भगवान के घर देर है, अंधेर नहीं।
reference: God's mills grind slow, but sure.
cultural_context: Deep spiritual reassurance of divine cosmic justice in Indian culture.

source_text: Bro, my laptop crashed right before saving the Excel sheet.
reference: Bhai, Excel sheet save karne se theek pehle laptop crash ho gaya.
cultural_context: Workplace tech mishap narrative in Hinglish.

source_text: The festival of Holi is celebrated with colors, sweets, and joy across India.
reference: भारत भर में होली का त्योहार रंगों, मिठाइयों और उल्लास के साथ मनाया जाता है।
cultural_context: Descriptive cultural text for India's festival of spring.

source_text: All that glitters is not gold.
reference: हर चमकने वाली चीज़ सोना नहीं होती।
cultural_context: Direct universally accepted Hindi translation.

source_text: चिराग तले अंधेरा होता है।
reference: The darkest place is under the candlestick.
cultural_context: 'चिराग तले अंधेरा' implies that hypocrisy or ignorance often exists right beside knowledge or virtue.

source_text: Don't take tension, we will figure it out step by step.
reference: Tension mat lo, hum step by step figure out kar lenge.
cultural_context: Comforting conversational tone blending English idioms with Hindi auxiliaries.

source_text: Customers can avail a 10% discount using UPI payments.
reference: ग्राहक यूपीआई (UPI) भुगतान का उपयोग करके 10% छूट प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
cultural_context: UPI payment ecosystem nomenclature ubiquitous in India.

source_text: Too many cooks spoil the broth.
reference: बहुत सारे जोगी, मठ उजाड़।
cultural_context: Indian cultural parallel: 'बहुत सारे जोगी, मठ उजाड़' (too many monks ruin the monastery).

source_text: अरे यार, वह तो छोटी-छोटी बातों पर तिल का ताड़ बना देता है।
reference: Man, he makes a huge fuss over the tiniest little things.
cultural_context: 'तिल का ताड़ बनाना' (turning a sesame seed into a palm tree) equals exaggerating immensely.

source_text: I will share the meeting minutes on Slack by end of day.
reference: Main EOD tak Slack pe meeting minutes share kar doonga.
cultural_context: Corporate abbreviations (EOD, Slack, meeting minutes) woven into Hindi verb endings.

source_text: Farmers across Punjab and Haryana celebrate Baisakhi as the harvest festival.
reference: पंजाब और हरियाणा के किसान बैसाखी को फसल कटाई के उत्सव के रूप में मनाते हैं।
cultural_context: Regional agrarian festival traditions.

source_text: Rome was not built in a day.
reference: हथेली पर सरसों नहीं जमती।
cultural_context: Classical Hindi agrarian proverb: 'हथेली पर सरसों नहीं जमती' (mustard doesn't sprout on palm overnight).

source_text: चलो, चाय पर चर्चा करते हैं।
reference: Come, let us discuss this over a cup of tea.
cultural_context: 'चाय पर चर्चा' (discussion over tea) is an iconic social and political cultural motif in modern India.

source_text: I am stuck in traffic, will reach the cafe in 20 minutes.
reference: Main traffic mein phansa hoon, 20 minute mein cafe pahunch jaunga.
cultural_context: Everyday commute update in Hinglish.

source_text: Please provide your Aadhaar card number for KYC verification.
reference: कृपया केवाईसी (KYC) सत्यापन के लिए अपना आधार कार्ड नंबर प्रदान करें।
cultural_context: India-specific identity document (Aadhaar) and KYC verification terminology.

source_text: A stitch in time saves nine.
reference: समय पर किया गया छोटा उपाय बड़ी मुसीबत से बचाता है।
cultural_context: Timely preventive intervention proverb translated with cultural clarity.

source_text: वह तो अपने मुंह मियां मिट्ठू बनता है।
reference: He is always singing his own praises.
cultural_context: 'अपने मुंह मियां मिट्ठू बनना' (calling oneself a parrot) describes self-adulation and bragging.

source_text: Can you please send me the location on Google Maps?
reference: Please mujhe Google Maps pe live location send kar do na?
cultural_context: Urban conversational plea with 'na' question particle and digital map sharing.

source_text: The Reserve Bank of India has announced a 25 basis points cut in the repo rate.
reference: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक ने रेपो दर में 25 आधार अंकों की कटौती की घोषणा की है।
cultural_context: Monetary policy terminology (भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक, आधार अंक, रेपो दर).

source_text: Bro, that new comedy series on Netflix is full paisa vasool!
reference: Bhai Netflix ki nayi comedy series poori paisa vasool hai!
cultural_context: 'Paisa vasool' (complete value for money) is quintessential Indian entertainment appreciation.

source_text: सबका साथ, सबका विकास ही हमारा संकल्प है।
reference: Together with all, development for all is our solemn commitment.
cultural_context: Prominent contemporary Indian governance and public policy motto.
